s00-01-story-36e3ac.wav.text: Two brothers walk out into a field.

s00-02-story-66e71d.wav.text: Only one of them walks back.

s00-03-talk-0e3130.wav.text: It is the first death in the Bible.

s00-04-story-97d727.wav.text: And it didn't start with a weapon.

s00-07-talk-7973e5.wav.text: It sounds like the easy commandment.

s00-08-story-31e759.wav.text: Most of us will never hurt anyone.

s00-09-pivot-ad6d7b.wav.text: But Jesus said it reaches much further than our hands.

s01-01-story-cfec47.wav.text: Cain and Abel were the first brothers.

s01-02-story-aba78f.wav.text: Cain worked the ground, and Abel kept the sheep.

s01-03-story-32cfcd.wav.text: Both brought an offering to God.

s01-04-story-f8cdbc.wav.text: God accepted Abel's offering, but not Cain's.

s01-07-story-21bd18.wav.text: So God warned him, the way you would warn a friend.

s01-08-grave-9e3c21.wav.text: And if you do not do well, sin is crouching at the door.

s01-09-grave-9e3886.wav.text: Its desire is for you, and you must rule over it.

s01-10-talk-faaf0a.wav.text: Anger was crouching at the door, like an animal.

s01-11-story-56f139.wav.text: Cain could still close that door.

s02-01-pivot-e73344.wav.text: But Cain didn't rule over it.

s02-02-story-a7e34b.wav.text: He asked his brother to come out to the field.

s02-03-story-13a1a8.wav.text: And there, Cain rose up against Abel and took his life.

s02-04-talk-b22e08.wav.text: The Bible tells it in one short sentence.

s02-05-story-c15e6f.wav.text: There are no details. Just a life that is gone.

s03-01-story-4225ab.wav.text: Then God came to Cain and asked where his brother was.

s03-03-story-b4caba.wav.text: Was he supposed to look after his brother?

s03-04-grave-3f70ac.wav.text: The voice of your brother's blood is crying to me from the ground.

s03-07-story-12d435.wav.text: Abel's life mattered to him, even when no one was left to speak for it.

s04-01-pivot-1270d6.wav.text: Why does one life matter that much?

s04-02-story-152f3e.wav.text: After the flood, God gives the reason.

s04-03-grave-4761cd.wav.text: God made man in his own image.

s04-04-talk-2ffd58.wav.text: Every person carries something of God, like a reflection in a mirror.

s04-05-talk-d0ee58.wav.text: To take a person's life is to strike at the one whose image they carry.

s05-01-story-9cc535.wav.text: So when God spoke from the mountain, the sixth word was short.

s05-04-story-51d6b5.wav.text: But the Hebrew word points to taking an innocent life.

s05-05-story-4f8df9.wav.text: That's why most modern Bibles say murder.

s05-06-talk-df31f9.wav.text: It sounds like a rule most of us keep without trying.

s06-02-story-a704c9.wav.text: On a hillside, he quoted the old command.

s06-04-grave-04fc33.wav.text: But I say to you that everyone who is angry with his brother will be liable to judgment.

s06-05-talk-80573a.wav.text: Jesus goes back to where Cain started.

s06-07-talk-21474e.wav.text: The angry word, the cruel name, the cold silence.

s06-08-story-1b573f.wav.text: They all grow from the same root.

s06-09-story-1a392f.wav.text: This commandment isn't only about our hands.

s07-01-pivot-22527f.wav.text: But there's a flip side too.

s07-02-talk-be6f03.wav.text: Christians have long read this commandment as a call to protect life, not just to avoid taking it.

s07-03-story-700936.wav.text: Jesus said that if your brother has something against you, go and make peace with him first.

s07-04-grave-045ee3.wav.text: For this is the message that you have heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

s07-05-talk-bdc394.wav.text: And the very next verse names Cain.

s07-06-talk-10b3cb.wav.text: Cain asked if he was his brother's keeper.

s07-07-story-5c82f2.wav.text: The answer, all along, was yes.

s08-01-story-b08399.wav.text: So guard your anger before it grows. Speak kindly.

s08-02-story-bd11c6.wav.text: Help the weak. Make peace quickly.

s08-03-grave-9d25f4.wav.text: Every person you meet carries the image of God.

s08-04-talk-9b9764.wav.text: Next time, the seventh commandment, and why God guards the promise of marriage.
